_doc: W17.3 cel-spec upstream pin record (VAL-W17-010). The celspec_commit_sha MUST equal the first non-comment line of PINNED_COMMIT.txt; the drift checker asserts the equality. The cel-python and cel-js fields record the pinned (NOT latest) runtime versions used for the per-PR conformance run; the nightly drift workflow (.github/workflows/nightly-cel-drift.yml) compares against the LATEST versions on PyPI/npm per VAL-W17-014. Bumping either runtime version REQUIRES bumping last_refreshed_at and (when vectors change) MANIFEST.sha256 + celspec_vectors.json.
